My feedback would be, however, to have more variety during lectures. Perhaps she could integrate PowerPoint presentations instead of writing everything on the board, which took time and although it was good for note-taking it could become monotonous. I also think the lectures would benefit visuals, images and videos that can be included. I would love if she included more detailed real-world examples and case-studies etc. in addition to those she does include. I think they make the subject much more engaging, which can otherwise remain rather abstract and superficial. She could expand on the examples she does give with visuals, for example. More in-class discussion would also be nice. I do realize that time limitations are a problem for the course, however.
All in all, thank you Ms Gürzumar once again :) Take care!
